characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Films and The Clone Wars)
characters.summary: Watto is a Toydarian junk dealer and merchant on Tatooine who relies entirely on his negotiation skills, hired muscle like mercenaries or slaves, and Toydarian natural flight to avoid physical confrontation.

mechanisms: Natural flight to evade ground threats
Immunity to some mind-influencing Force tricks due to Toydarian physiology

limitations: Physically weak and unsuited for direct combat
Cannot be influenced by standard Jedi mind tricks

sources.supports: Toydarian physiology, resistance to Force mind tricks, and occupation as a junk dealer on Tatooine.

feats.claim: Resisted Qui-Gon Jinn's attempt to use a Jedi mind trick to accept Republic dataries.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace

campaignTags.claim: Toydarians possess wings that allow them to fly naturally.

unknowns: Exact limits of Toydarian resistance to various psychic or mental manipulations outside of standard Jedi mind tricks.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Original Trilogy and Expanded Media)
characters.summary: Wedge Antilles is an elite veteran starfighter pilot of the Rebel Alliance and New Republic who specializes in commanding squadrons and destroying large enemy capital ships and installations.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when his starfighter is disabled or outside a vehicle
limitations: Relies entirely on standard military equipment and starfighters for offensive power.

sources.supports: Status as a premier Rebel pilot, participation in the Death Star trenches, and squadron leadership.

feats.claim: Participated in the destruction of both the first and second Death Stars.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope and Star Wars: Episode VI – Return of the Jedi

notableResults.note: Flew as Red Two in the assault on the Death Star.

conditional.dependsOn: Piloting an X-wing or similar starfighter

campaignTags.claim: Pilots X-wing starfighters in major battles.

unknowns: Extent of hand-to-hand combat proficiency outside of standard military training.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Return of the Jedi and The Clone Wars)
characters.summary: Wicket W. Warrick is a courageous Ewok warrior who uses primitive traps, forest terrain knowledge, and small-scale projectile weapons to fight heavily armored adversaries.
weaknesses: Low physical durability against heavy energy weapons and explosions
limitations: Weapons are restricted to primitive spears, bows, and slingshots.

sources.supports: Ewok warrior tactics, weapon usage, and role in the Battle of Endor.

feats.claim: Helped defeat Imperial stormtroopers during the Battle of Endor using traps and primitive weapons.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode VI – Return of the Jedi

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode VI – Return of the Jedi
notableResults.note: Fought alongside Rebel forces using environmental traps.

campaignTags.claim: Constructs and utilizes complex rope snares and forest traps.

unknowns: Effectiveness of Ewok weaponry against specialized non-Imperial armor.

characters.summary: Wrecker is a genetically modified clone commando who possesses immense superhuman strength, specializing in heavy weapons, demolition, and close-quarters brawling.

mechanisms: Exceptional physical durability and pain tolerance

weaknesses: Susceptible to psychological distress when inhibitor chips activate
mobility: Jetpack or ship piloting as passenger
limitations: Prone to recklessness when overwhelmed by battle frenzy.

sources.supports: Genetically enhanced strength, role as demolitionist for Clone Force 99, and use of heavy armor.

feats.claim: Lifted a heavy LAAT/i gunship gun-turret section entirely by hand.

notableResults.note: Engaged multiple troopers in close quarters and prevailed.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of his lifting capacity.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Films and The Clone Wars)
characters.summary: Yoda is a master of the Force and lightsaber combat with centuries of experience, capable of devastating telekinetic feats, precognition, and swift acrobatic strikes.
weaknesses: Advanced age and small physical stature can be taxed in prolonged wars of attrition, though compensated by the Force
mobility: Acrobatic leaps enhanced by the Force
limitations: Relies on connection to the Force for peak physical agility.

sources.supports: Mastery of the Force, lightsaber skills, and historical feats against Sith Lords.

feats.claim: Caught and redirected Count Dooku's unleashed Force lightning bare-handed.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones

feats.claim: Lifted Luke Skywalker's X-wing starfighter out of the swamps of Dagobah using telekinesis.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode V – The Empire Strikes Back

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones
notableResults.note: Dooku escaped while Yoda saved Anakin and Obi-Wan.

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith
notableResults.note: Fought in the Galactic Senate chamber; environmental disadvantage forced Yoda into exile.

campaignTags.claim: Wields advanced Force powers comparable to magical casting in combat.
Lifts massive objects like starfighters and heavy debris using the Force.
Communicates across vast distances and senses thoughts through the Force.

unknowns: Full potential of post-mortal Force ghost abilities in a direct material confrontation.

characters.summary: Garazeb "Zeb" Orrelios is a Lasat honor guard veteran who combines brutal physical strength with an energy Bo-rifle that functions as both a rifle and an electrostaff.
weaknesses: Prone to hotheadedness and emotional provocation in combat
mobility: Acrobatic leaps for a large humanoid
limitations: Relies on standard gear and weapon charges for energy attacks.

sources.supports: Lasat physiology, Bo-rifle usage, and combat history with the Spectres.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple Imperial stormtroopers simultaneously in hand-to-hand combat.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill on an ice moon before eventually forming an alliance.

campaignTags.claim: Uses a Bo-rifle capable of firing energy blasts and discharging electricity in staff mode.

unknowns: Full extent of Lasat martial arts techniques outside of standard military training.
